title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard — WorkPass32
workpass: 32 — bounded fuzzy lexical retrieval and independent rank fusion
method: WorkPass32 adds candidate discovery through a bounded character-trigram token index and fuses BM25, query token coverage, fuzzy lexical similarity, entities, and graph/temporal evidence. The hashed-token projection is not treated as a semantic embedding. Synthetic typo/inflection cases pass, but no independent labelled temporal retrieval improvement is established; overall readiness score stays unchanged.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: MemoryOS2 remains the sole writable owner. WorkPass31 centralizes all current production mutation classes behind MemoryFabric and persists a bounded receipt ledger through ordinary state migration; legacy direct-write adapter methods remain only for historical consumers.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Current production Hexis, external-research and compatibility restore paths route through the common lifecycle mutation API; focused runtime and normal migration regressions pass. Browser/Live2D production E2E remains open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass32 adds bounded fuzzy candidate discovery and hybrid RRF over BM25, query coverage, character similarity, entities and graph/temporal relationships; it removes false semantic weight from a hash-only vector. Controlled typo/inflection regressions pass, but the offline synthetic evaluation remains not-promoted and independent labelled temporal holdout is still open.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass20 adds exact action execution/step receipt correlation and a persisted bounded idempotency ledger; duplicate/stale receipts cannot advance later project steps. Entire action→independent external receipt→reafference chain remains partial.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass25 supplies a deterministic private-first temperature-scaling fitter with a group-disjoint validation fold, version/dataset-bound artifact contract, NLL/Brier/ECE eligibility thresholds and provenance propagation into evidence/restore. This is an implemented pipeline only: the real pinned pretrained model and independent final holdout have not been run.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Release metadata and operational readiness reporting improved; dependency-complete app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room restore/rollback, soak and final SBOM/provenance remain open.

normalizedTaskInventory.note: Normalized unique deliverables, not append-only historical tasklist line counts. PARTIAL is not treated as DONE. This inventory score does not establish release readiness.

openReleaseGates: Real autonomous research on at least two allowed external HTTPS hosts with distinct evidence and persisted source receipt
Real pretrained NLI inference on a fixed labelled, domain-relevant adversarial holdout; threshold review must remain separate from evaluation; multilingual/domain compatibility is unproven
Complete agency loop from competition to independent postcondition, persistence and reafference with cross-consumer no-double-credit
Entity correction/expiry/conflict across browser-backed multi-session flows
Portable subject continuity and behavioral fidelity
Capability evidence graph for critical user journeys
External provider delivery receipts, reconnect and replay guarantees
Clean-room backup/restore, schema migration and rollback drill
Research candidate integrations from NeuroCore/NOMEGA/DeepCode only where they measurably beat canonical baselines
Authorization/abuse/rate-limit review for diagnostic and benchmark APIs
Independent labelled temporal MemoryOS2 holdout run against the implemented Okapi BM25 baseline; corrected synthetic fixture is at parity; no real-corpus uplift is established
Dependency-complete app install and root/app semantic typecheck
Desktop/mobile browser E2E, including actual Live2D interaction
Multi-hour soak with memory and resource-growth limits
Final SBOM, license inventory and immutable release provenance sign-off
environmentNote: WorkPass31 runtime TypeScript, replay-safe lifecycle mutation, normal migratePersistedOrganism preservation/sanitization, compatibility restore, provenance-lineage and source-integration regressions pass. The bounded receipt journal is persisted and replay-safe within its 512-entry contract. No retrieval uplift or release readiness is claimed; independent labelled temporal holdout, frontend production/browser Live2D E2E, real NLI/provider runs, recovery/rollback, soak and sign-off remain open.
limitations: WorkPass31 closes the canonical memory-mutation/idempotency persistence seam but does not claim higher retrieval quality. Independent human-labelled temporal holdout, dependency-complete frontend build/browser Live2D E2E, actual pretrained NLI inference, live provider evidence, clean-room recovery/rollback, soak and final RC sign-off remain open.
